# Laws with noise: path by path, and in expectation

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`laws-with-noise` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](laws-with-noise.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A law of exchange with noise is a relation of exchange, every realization's course a run of it, so the laws hold path by path; balance passes to the expectation, and rest does not.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A law with noise is the relation of exchange opening what some noise value gives; along every realization its course is a run, and the world read off it a world read off a relation of exchange. (`Becoming.NoisyLaw`, `Becoming.NoisyLaw.course_runs`, `Becoming.NoisyLaw.readOffExchange`, `Becoming.NoisyLaw.realize`, `Becoming.NoisyLaw.relation`)
2. Balance holds in expectation over any distribution of the noise with integrable amounts; a condition ending at a random step rests along every realization while its expected level falls at every step. (`Becoming.Representation.RandomEnd.expected`, `Becoming.Representation.RandomEnd.level`, `Becoming.Representation.RandomEnd.rest_not_in_expectation`, `Becoming.Representation.RandomEnd.rests`, `Becoming.Representation.RandomEnd.summable_weighted`, `Becoming.Representation.RandomEnd.weight`, `Becoming.Representation.expected_balance`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No premise in the core declarations; the periphery uses Lean's standard axioms through Mathlib and names integrability where it enters.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Laws reading a distribution of exchanges rather than a realization; that an actual noise is a value read at each step.
- **Counterexample:** RandomEnd.rest_not_in_expectation: rest along every realization, none in expectation. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/representation/Representation.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.
